items.title_en: Testing AI's Ability to Build Infrastructure with InfraDev
summary_en: Existing AI benchmarks focus on simple tasks, but InfraDev tests complex infrastructure changes across multiple GPUs.
InfraDev uses 36 real-world tasks from AI projects to evaluate coding agents' ability to fix and improve systems.
Hidden probes help assess whether agents' code works correctly in real infrastructure scenarios.
key_points_en: InfraDev tests infrastructure changes across multiple GPUs
36 tasks from real AI projects like Megatron-LM
Hidden probes evaluate code correctness
translation_zh: 现有AI基准测试关注简单任务，但InfraDev测试跨多个GPU的复杂基础设施更改。
InfraDev使用来自Megatron-LM等AI项目的36个真实任务来评估编码代理改进系统的能力。
隐藏探针用于评估代码在真实基础设施场景中的正确性。

vocab.zh: 可投入实际使用的AI基础设施

items.title_en: MLE-World: A New Tool for Predicting ML Experiment Results
summary_en: MLE-World is a model that predicts outcomes of machine learning experiments without actually running them.
It uses a confidence score to show how reliable its predictions are.
This approach saves time by avoiding expensive training runs.
key_points_en: Predicts experiment results without executing code
Includes confidence scores for predictions
Reduces need for training runs
translation_zh: MLE-World是一种无需实际运行机器学习实验即可预测结果的模型。
它使用置信度分数来显示预测的可靠性。
这种方法通过避免耗时的训练过程来节省时间。

items.title_en: New AI Method Improves Diabetes Risk Prediction Accuracy
summary_en: Current diabetes risk prediction models focus more on accuracy than reliability. Researchers created a new framework using patient data and AI to better predict blood sugar changes.
The study used data from 736 type 1 diabetes patients to test predictions at 30, 60, and 120-minute intervals.
key_points_en: AI framework improves reliability of diabetes predictions
Uses data from 736 type 1 diabetes patients
Tests predictions at 30-120 minute intervals
translation_zh: 当前糖尿病风险预测模型更关注准确性而非可靠性。研究人员创建了一个新框架，利用患者数据和AI更好地预测血糖变化。
该研究使用736名1型糖尿病患者的数据，在30-120分钟的时间间隔内测试预测效果。

items.title_en: Microsoft Stock Rises 4% on Strong Cloud Revenue Growth
summary_en: Microsoft's stock increased by 4% after the company reported higher-than-expected earnings.
The growth was mainly due to a 48% increase in Azure revenue, driven by strong demand in the cloud computing sector.
key_points_en: Microsoft stock rose 4% following strong earnings
Azure revenue grew 48% year-over-year
Cloud computing demand drove the financial results
translation_zh: 微软的股价上涨了4%，因为公司报告了超出预期的收益。
这一增长主要归功于Azure收入增长48%，这是云计算领域强劲需求的结果。

items.title_en: Jeff Gundlach Questions Fed's Rate Pause Decision
summary_en: Bond investor Jeff Gundlach asked the Federal Reserve why it paused interest rates during an interview on CNBC's 'Closing Bell'.
The Fed decided to keep rates unchanged after a meeting, prompting Gundlach's public reaction.
Gundlach's comments highlight concerns about the timing of monetary policy decisions.
key_points_en: Fed held interest rates steady
Gundlach questioned the pause decision
Interview occurred on CNBC's 'Closing Bell'
translation_zh: 债券投资者杰夫·冈德拉奇在CNBC的《收盘钟》节目中询问美联储为何暂停利率。
美联储在会议后决定保持利率不变，引发冈德拉奇的公开反应。
冈德拉奇的评论凸显了对货币政策时机的担忧。

items.title_en: 10-Year Treasury Yield Rises as Fed Holds Rates Steady
summary_en: The 10-year Treasury yield increased slightly as investors wait for the Federal Reserve's next monetary policy move.
Despite the Fed maintaining current interest rates, market expectations for future changes may be influencing bond prices.
key_points_en: The 10-year Treasury yield increased slightly.
The Federal Reserve has kept interest rates unchanged.
Market participants are waiting for the Fed's next policy decision.
translation_zh: 10年期美国国债收益率小幅上涨，投资者正等待美联储下一步货币政策决定。
尽管美联储维持当前利率不变，但市场对未来变化的预期可能影响债券价格。

items.title_en: Upwind Secures $400M Funding Instead of Accepting Datadog Buyout Offer
summary_en: Cloud security company Upwind raised $400 million in Series C funding at a $3.8 billion valuation.
The startup chose to reject Datadog's acquisition offer for the same price.
This decision shows confidence in Upwind's growth potential.
key_points_en: Upwind raised $400M in Series C funding
Rejected Datadog's acquisition offer
Valuation reached $3.8 billion
translation_zh: 云安全公司Upwind以38亿美元估值筹集了4亿美元的C轮融资
该初创公司拒绝了Datadog以相同价格收购的提议
这一决定显示出对Upwind增长潜力的信心

items.title_en: New Wired Headset Xreal Aura Uses Android XR Technology
summary_en: Xreal Aura is a new wired headset that runs on Android XR technology.
It will be available starting at $1,279 and will come with several XR-specific apps when it launches.
key_points_en: Priced at $1,279 starting
Powered by Android XR
Includes multiple XR apps at launch
translation_zh: Xreal Aura是一款使用安卓XR技术的有线头显。
它将从1279美元起售，并在发布时附带多个XR专用应用。

items.title_en: Google Expands AI Integration for Developers
summary_en: Google has launched a new platform allowing businesses to integrate their services with AI tools like Gemini and Search.
This move could change how users find and use apps on the internet.
key_points_en: New developer platform enables business integration with Google's AI tools
Gemini and Search are now accessible to third-party apps
Potential shift in app discovery methods for consumers
translation_zh: 谷歌推出新平台，允许企业将其服务与Gemini和搜索等AI工具集成。
此举可能改变用户在互联网上发现和使用应用程序的方式。
